$comment: SKETCH — discussion artifact for D-022, 2026-07-27. Not a standalone schema: this is the amendment to schema/entry.v1.json. Three edits: (1) `type` enum gains "reference"; (2) the base gains five nullable fields (kind, body, source, discipline, work_phase) — all default null, all must-null on pack/step entries, all registered in schema/RESERVED.md per accretion-only rules; (3) a third allOf branch, below. OPEN QUESTION (header note): entries stay `schema: 1` on the theory that the tolerant reader preserves unknown types and only strict validation flags them on old code; if that's judged too loose, reference entries carry `schema: 2` and the const moves to an enum [1,2]. Decide before build. `work_phase` also lands on step entries (D-023) — that half of the amendment is one optional field and is not repeated here.

kind.description: Reference-only. Default: null (must be null/absent on pack and step entries). The razor, as a discriminator: exemplar = an owned artifact whose shape should be reproduced; rubric = the checklist the user reviews against; gotcha = what the model gets wrong unprompted. Required on reference entries. Anything that fits none of the three is distilled or declined at ingest — there is deliberately no fourth 'article' kind.

body.description: Reference-only. Inline markdown content — the rubric checklist or the gotcha text. Required on rubric and gotcha kinds; null on exemplars (their content is the artifact itself, via `source`). Kept inline rather than as a sidecar file so a reference entry remains one readable, diffable JSON file (file-over-app); if rubrics outgrow inline comfort (~40 lines?), revisit with a sidecar-.md pattern — flagged as an open question, not decided here.

source.description: Reference-only. Path or URL to an artifact the user owns — a repo path, a deployed page, a file. Required on exemplar kind; optional on rubric/gotcha (a rubric may cite the exemplar it was distilled from). Unlike pack `url`, this usually points at the user's own work, so lazy verification asks 'does this still exist / is this still my taste?' rather than 'is this package alive?'.

discipline.description: Reference-only in this sketch (could later apply to steps). Free string — 'engineering', 'copy', 'design', 'product' — deliberately NOT an enum: recorded at ingest, shown as context on cards and used by gate judgment, never a hard filter and never a folder. Same recorded-not-enforced posture as pack `stack` (PRD §4, not-a-taxonomy).

work_phase.description: Reference and step entries (D-023). Which kind of work this applies to; null = any. Compile groups field-guide checklists by this field. Delivery honesty: only `planning` has a verified push trigger today (the ExitPlanMode hook); other values are pull-at-start checklist material until their triggers are confirmed live.

surfaces_when.$comment: Reused from pack entries verbatim: the gate matches on it, the dismissal ledger counts against it, supersession chains work unchanged. This reuse is the whole argument for expanding Scout rather than building a parallel system.

ambient_line.$comment: OPTIONAL on references (required on pack entries). References compile into their own field-guide section with its own cap and never compete for the pack manifest's ~25 lines. Strawman: gotchas usually want an ambient_line (always-relevant warnings); exemplars and rubrics usually surface via work_phase checklists and leave this null. Cap size for the reference section: open (strawman ~10).

body.$comment: required when kind is rubric or gotcha — enforced in a nested if/then on kind, elided in this sketch

source.$comment: required when kind is exemplar — same nested enforcement, elided

example-entries.title: Landing-page copy rubric
surfaces_when: a reviewer agent is being briefed on website copy
example-entries.body:
- Headline states the outcome, not the feature
- One idea per section; cut the second clause
- CTA verbs are specific ('Start the scan'), never 'Learn more'
- Read it aloud: anything you wouldn't say, delete
example-entries.notes: Distilled from the two pages I actually liked; supersedes nothing yet.

example-entries.title: Drop landing page — copy + layout shape
surfaces_when: building a marketing or landing page for a developer-facing tool
example-entries.notes: The shape I want reproduced: short hero, one screenshot, three-beat feature rhythm.

example-entries.title: No barrel files
example-entries.ambient_line: Never add barrel files (index.ts re-exports) — direct imports only.
example-entries.body: Models default to barrel files; I never want them. Direct imports only, even when it means longer import paths.
example-entries.notes: The kind of thing I correct every single project — exactly why gotchas exist.
